Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for IISER Tirupati Project Assistant Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for the Project Assistant post at IISER Tirupati?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Project Assistant post at IISER Tirupati is scheduled for 15 September 2026. Candidates should ensure they attend on this date.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Project Assistant position?
faq.answer: Candidates should possess a Graduate degree or B.Sc. with at least 50% or an equivalent grade to be eligible for the Project Assistant role.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Project Assistant position is not more than 50 years as per the official notification.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary offered for the Project Assistant role?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Project Assistant position will receive a salary of INR 20,000 plus 9% HRA.

faq.question: Q5. How many vacancies are available for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: There is one vacancy available for the Project Assistant post at IISER Tirupati.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is Walk-in. Candidates need to attend the interview in person.

faq.question: Q7. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: You should carry your application form, passport-size photographs, and photocopies of relevant certificates and testimonials supporting your age, qualification, and experience.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any experience required for the Project Assistant post?
faq.answer: While a Graduate degree is the minimum qualification, experience in fieldwork, ecological research, bird song recording, Raven Pro analysis, and LiDAR data analysis is desirable.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection process for the Project Assistant recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process involves an initial screening of applications followed by an interview.

faq.question: Q10. Where is IISER Tirupati located?
faq.answer: IISER Tirupati is located in Tirupati, Andhra Pradesh, with the pincode 517619.
